title: No\=esis: Deterministic-First Retrieval with Two-Tier Context Hydration for Factuality-Critical Queries on Small Local Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.07663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A wrong number is worse than no answer. Across factuality-critical domains -- audience metrics, scheduling and rights in media; dosages and lab values in healthcare; figures and citations in finance and legal -- a confident but fabricated value is more damaging than an honest admission of uncertainty. Yet this is the dominant failure mode we observe on small local language models: even when correct evidence is present in context, models fabricate plausible numbers and timestamps. Recent work characterizes a real limit of this regime: below 7B parameters, the bottleneck of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is not retrieval quality but context utilization.   We present Noesis, the deterministic-first query plane of the Noesis architecture, which makes every deterministic judgment before generation. Its mechanisms follow from the ingestion architecture (subject of a separate patent application): (a) a producer-side fact layer rendering

translated_title: No=esis：面向小型本地模型事实关键型查询的确定性优先检索与两级上下文水合机制
translated_abstract: 一个错误的数字比没有答案更糟糕。在事实关键的各个领域——媒体领域的观众指标、排期与版权；医疗领域的剂量与化验数值；金融与法律领域的数字与引用——一个自信却捏造的数值，比诚实地承认不确定性更具破坏性。然而，这正是我们在小型本地语言模型上观察到的主要失效模式：即使正确的证据已经存在于上下文中，模型仍会编造看似合理的数字和时间戳。近期的研究刻画了这一范式的真实局限：在70亿（7B）参数以下，检索增强生成（RAG）的瓶颈不在于检索质量，而在于上下文利用。我们提出了Noesis——Noesis架构中的确定性优先查询平面，它在生成之前完成所有确定性判断。其机制源自该系统的摄取架构（已另行提交专利申请）：一种生产者端的事实层，用于渲染……（原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 针对参数量低于7B的小型本地语言模型在事实关键查询中即便证据在手仍编造数字与时间戳的问题，本文提出Noesis确定性优先查询平面，通过在生成前完成所有确定性判断、结合两级上下文水合机制，将RAG的瓶颈从检索质量转向提升上下文利用率。
en_tdlr: Noesis is a deterministic-first query plane that performs all deterministic judgments before generation and uses two-tier context hydration to combat number fabrication in sub-7B local language models, addressing the finding that in this regime the RAG bottleneck is context utilization rather than retrieval quality.
